metas.name: Good Night
metas.description: Good Night was the first ever Simpsons short to air on The Tracey Ullman Show. The five main family members - Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa, and Maggie - were first introduced in this short. Homer and Marge attempt to calm their children to sleep, with the opposite results. metas.name: Watching TV
metas.description: Bart and Lisa quarrel during commercial breaks over what channel they'll watch. Repeatedly Maggie comes up to the television and changes the channel. Later Homer is saying some speech about family matters then stops when the show comes back on. A piece of music from the Tracey Ul

metas.name: Jumping Bart
metas.description: Homer makes several attempts to have Bart jump into his arms. Each time Bart jumps Homer is distracted and fails to catch him. Towards the end of the episode boxing gloves are delivered, presumably the ones used in the episode Punching Bag.

metas.name: Babysitting Maggie
metas.description: Marge puts Bart and Lisa in charge of babysitting Maggie. They watch TV while Maggie gets electrocuted, falls down the stairs, and falls off the roof.  Maggie sticks a fork in an electrical socket thereby electocuting herself, she crawls up the stairs and falls down them in insan

metas.name: The Pacifier
metas.description: Lisa and Bart try to get Maggie to stop sucking on her pacifier, but Maggie, who has an entire drawer full of them, refuses to kick the habit.

metas.name: Burping Contest
metas.description: Despite Marge's objections, Bart, Lisa and even Maggie compete in a contest to see who can make the most disgusting burp.

metas.name: Dinner Time
metas.description: Marge serves the family purple goop for dinner, insisting that they say grace first.

metas.name: Making Faces
metas.description: Despite Marge's warnings, the kids make faces. Maggie unclearly speaks in this episode.

metas.name: The Funeral
metas.description: Bart is determined to see his uncle's corpse...but not for long. This is the only appearance of Uncle Hubert.

metas.name: Maggie's Brain
metas.description: Bart and Lisa wonder what's inside Maggie's mind.

metas.name: Football
metas.description: Homer teaches Bart about the importance of Football.

metas.name: House of Cards
metas.description: Bart tries to make a house of cards, but Lisa Maggie make noises that have the "house" fall every time.

metas.name: Bart and Homer's Dinner
metas.description: Bart can't stomach it when he and Homer are forced to fend for themselves.

metas.name: Space Patrol
metas.description:
Bart, Lisa and Maggie play a game of "Space Patrol" while Homer and Marge are out.  Lisa plays a superhero with Maggie as her sidekick, while Bart puts a jug on his head with the pretense of it being the helmet of an alien warlord.

However, his head accidentally plops into it an

metas.name: Bart's Haircut
metas.description: Bart has his hair cut too short by a barber.  This is the first time we hear a character from The Simpsons series say a curse word.

metas.name: World War III
metas.description: Homer wakes up the family to practice for a nuclear drill... in the middle of the night.

metas.name: The Perfect Crime
metas.description: Marge bakes a batch of delicious cookies. Bart attempts to steal them, but burns his fingers trying to pick them up. Everyone except Bart and Maggie leave the kitchen to let them cool down, and Bart takes this opportunity to swipe them, muttering to himself "Aha! The perfect crim

metas.name: Scary Stories
metas.description: Bart tells Lisa & Maggie a series of scary stories (in the middle of the dark) only to believe they're coming true.

metas.name: Grampa and the Kids
metas.description: Grampa spends time with the kids.  This is Grampa's first appearance.

metas.name: Gone Fishin' (Sort of)
metas.description: Bart and Homer go on a fishing trip. Homer asks Bart for a bologna sandwich, but Bart forgot the bologna. He puts the bait on the sandwich instead. Later on they hit rapids and Homer is almost knocked unconscious. They later fall off of a waterfall.

metas.name: Skateboarding
metas.description: Bart teaches his sisters how to skateboard...or is it the other way around.

metas.name: The Pagans
metas.description: The kids discuss paganism.  This is the first time Bart calls his dad "Homer".

metas.name: Closeted
metas.description: Bart locks himself in the closet, and when he busts out, he finds out that the family has gone out without him.

metas.name: The Aquarium
metas.description: At an aquarium Bart swims with the sharks...literally.  This is the first time we see a naked Simpsons character.  This also marks Lisa Simpson saying the word hell in this short.

metas.name: Family Portrait
metas.description: Homer has trouble taking a normal family portrait.

metas.name: Bart's Hiccups
metas.description: Lisa and Maggie try to cure Bart's hiccups...the hard way.

metas.name: The Money Jar
metas.description: The kids try to steal money from Marge's money jar..

metas.name: The Art Museum
metas.description: The Simpsons go to the art museum.  This is the first time we hear Bart say "Whoooa, Mama!".

metas.name: Zoo Story
metas.description: Homer unwisely teases a monkey at the zoo and gets a faceful of poo for his trouble.  This is the shortest Simpsons Short.

metas.name: Shut Up, Simpsons
metas.description: Maggie squeaks her toy, causing a chain reaction of anger in the family.

metas.name: Shell Game
metas.description: Bart tries to hide the cookies he stole from the jar from his parents.

metas.name: The Bart Simpson Show
metas.description: Bart puts on his own show after Homer tells him to stop watching cartoons. First appearance of Itchy and Scratchy.  This is the first time we hear Lisa call her dad "Homer".

metas.name: Punching Bag
metas.description: Bart, Lisa and eventually Marge take out their frustrations on a punching bag with Homer's picture on it.

metas.name: Simpsons Christmas
metas.description: Bart's version of Christmas.

metas.name: The Krusty the Clown Show
metas.description: The kids get to see Krusty's show live for the first time. First appearance of Krusty the Clown.

metas.name: Bart the Hero
metas.description: Sent out to exercise, Bart foils a robbery attempt.

metas.name: Bart's Little Fantasy
metas.description: Bart tells a story about large kids who throw their small parents into a small room.

metas.name: Scary Movie
metas.description: Bart, Lisa and Maggie go to the movie to see "The Happy Little Elves Return" (much to Bart's dismay), but Bart convinces the girls to see "Space Mutants" instead. Guess who's the scaredy-cat!

metas.name: Home Hypnotism
metas.description: Homer tries hypnosis to calm down his crazy kids.

metas.name: Shoplifting
metas.description: Bart's attempt to swipe some chocolate is foiled.

metas.name: Echo Canyon
metas.description: The family drives to Echo Canyon, takes turns making echoes, and Bart almost makes a boulder crunch the family car.

metas.name: Bathtime
metas.description: Homer makes Bart take his "Sunday Night Bath", only to flood the bathroom.  this is the last Simpsons short in which we see a naked Simpsons character.

metas.name: Bart's Nightmare
metas.description: In this sequel to "Shell Game", Bart has a nightmare after eating every single cookie from the cookie jar.

metas.name: Bart of the Jungle
metas.description: The kids swing from the trees off Homer's ties.

metas.name: Family Therapy
metas.description: Homer takes the family to a psychologist.  This is last Tracey Ullman Short we hear a character from The Simpsons series say a curse word.

metas.name: Maggie in Peril (1)
metas.description: Bart kicks Maggie's ball out of sight and she takes off to retrieve it back.

metas.name: Maggie in Peril (The Thrilling Conclusion) (2)
metas.description: Maggie floats in the air hanging on to balloons and lands safely back in her playpen.

metas.name: TV Simpsons
metas.description: Homer attempts to fix the television antenna on the roof.
